question: Which of the following cities won the hosting rights of the 2030 Asian Games in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Doha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

• Asian games are also called Asiad and it is held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
